svg.title: Browser Use: hand a web goal to a browsing sub-agent
svg.desc: The host model calls browse_web with one natural-language goal. BrowserUse hands it to a browser-use sub-agent, which by default runs on the host run's model. The sub-agent reads the page as indexed DOM elements and a screenshot, picks an action, and repeats for up to 50 steps in its own Chromium session, behind a domain allowlist. A judge call checks the result, and browse_web returns the final text or validated JSON to the host model, with any secrets replaced by placeholders.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
